title: AC1027 modeler physical-owner closure
scope: Reject AC1027 ACDSDATA/SAB projection when a modeler's explicit entity owner disagrees with its physical modelspace, paperspace, or named-block owner.

reproduction.control: Generated ASCII and binary DXF cases retain an exact modeler handle/key/payload association but assign a block-contained 3DSOLID or REGION to a different, valid BLOCK_RECORD; a modelspace case points to a user-block record instead.
reproduction.beforeFix: Both encodings exported successfully and replaced the pre-existing destination sentinel.

implementation.behavior: The AC1027 DataStorage preflight validates explicit modeler parentHandle against the containing block's BLOCK_RECORD identity; modelspace and paperspace use their matching record or canonical fixed handle. Unspecified owner handles retain the writer's existing physical-container fallback.
positiveOwnerControls: ASCII and binary explicit modelspace owner
ASCII and binary explicit paperspace owner
negativeOwnerControls: ASCII and binary named-block 3DSOLID and REGION with another valid block owner
ASCII and binary modelspace modeler with a user-block owner
